columns.rationale: Invoice identifier landed as VARCHAR with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 2330 across 45228 rows; sample_values such as "489434" and "489443" are digit-only but are kept as text because retail invoice identifiers are codes, not arithmetic quantities.

Product code landed as VARCHAR with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 3141; sample_values mix pure digits ("10002", "10080") with alphanumerics ("10002R", "10123C"), so the samples disagree on a numeric shape and the column stays text.

Free-text product description with null_count 228 (null_rate 0.005041) and distinct_count 3045, so nulls are retained rather than imputed; sample_values such as " 3 STRIPEY MICE FELTCRAFT" and " BROWN  PIRATE TREASURE CHEST " carry leading and trailing whitespace that this cleanup does not normalise.

Landed as DECIMAL(38,9) with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 233, but every sample value is integral (-1395.0, -1043.0, -1012.0, -954.0) and min -1395.0 / max 5184.0 fit INTEGER, so the decimal scale is dropped.

quantity has min -1395.0 and ten negative sample_values (-1395.0 through -504.0) while max is 5184.0, so a boolean flag marks the negative-quantity rows that represent returns or corrections rather than sales.

Landed as VARCHAR with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 2004; all ten sample_values are ISO-shaped timestamps ("2009-12-01 07:45:00" through "2009-12-01 09:50:00"), supporting a TIMESTAMP cast, and the name is renamed to snake_case.

Landed as DECIMAL(38,9) with null_rate 0.0, distinct_count 295, min 0.0 and max 1998.49; every sample value (0.0, 0.04, 0.06, 0.18) carries at most two decimal places, so DECIMAL(10,2) holds the full observed range without loss.

Landed as DECIMAL(38,9) with integral sample_values (12346.0, 12349.0, 18287.0 as max, 12346.0 as min), so an INTEGER cast is safe; null_count 13468 (null_rate 0.29778) means nearly a third of rows are unattributed guest or anonymous transactions and those nulls are retained.
Low-cardinality VARCHAR with distinct_count 24 and null_rate 0.0; sample_values are country names such as "Australia", "Channel Islands", "EIRE" and "Germany", kept as text labels.
Marked is_airbyte_metadata: true; a per-row capture UUID with distinct_count 45228 equal to row_count, carrying no business meaning.
Marked is_airbyte_metadata: true; distinct_values are only "2026-07-27T10:24:46" and "2026-07-27T10:24:47", which record the load run rather than the business event.
Marked is_airbyte_metadata: true; distinct_count 1 with the single distinct value "{}", so it carries no information at all.

decisions.rationale: dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.011188 over row_count 45228, roughly 506 rows that repeat an existing row exactly; silver collapses byte-identical business rows to one, and the capture metadata columns are dropped first so Airbyte raw ids cannot make a duplicate look distinct.

invoice (distinct_count 2330), stockcode (distinct_count 3141) and invoice_date (distinct_count 2004) are the three non-null, required attributes that together identify one invoice line; a reviewer must measure this against the warehouse because a single invoice can legitimately repeat a stockcode on separate lines, in which case the grain needs widening or a line sequence.

_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at and _airbyte_meta all carry is_airbyte_metadata: true and describe the load (distinct_count 1 for _airbyte_meta, two load timestamps for _airbyte_extracted_at), so none of them reach silver.
customer_id has null_count 13468 of 45228 rows (null_rate 0.29778); those transactions are real sales without an attributed customer, so the nulls are retained and no rows are dropped or imputed.
quantity landed as DECIMAL(38,9) but every sample value is integral and min -1395.0 / max 5184.0 fit comfortably in INTEGER, so the spurious decimal scale is removed.
price landed as DECIMAL(38,9) with min 0.0, max 1998.49 and all sample_values at two decimal places or fewer, so DECIMAL(10,2) is the honest currency type.

invoicedate landed as VARCHAR but all ten sample_values match "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (for example "2009-12-01 07:45:00"), so the cast is supported by every observed sample and the column is renamed to invoice_date.

stockcode sample_values mix digits and alphanumerics ("10002" alongside "10002R" and "10123C"), and invoice is an identifier code rather than a measure, so both stay VARCHAR instead of being cast to a numeric type.

quantity has min -1395.0 and ten negative sample_values, so an is_return boolean derived from the sign of quantity lets consumers separate returns and corrections from sales without re-deriving the condition.

description sample_values such as " ANIMAL STICKERS" and " BROWN  PIRATE TREASURE CHEST " carry leading, trailing and doubled internal whitespace across distinct_count 3045 values; trimming would change distinct counts, so it is left for a reviewer to decide.

purpose: silver_online_retail_ii is the cleaned, typed line-item view of the bronze online_retail_ii capture (45228 rows): one row per invoice line with proper INTEGER quantity, DECIMAL(10,2) price, TIMESTAMP invoice_date and no Airbyte capture columns. It feeds downstream sales, returns and customer-level aggregates.
usage: Read it at invoice / stockcode / invoice_date grain. Rows where is_return is true have negative quantity (min -1395.0) and represent returns or corrections, so filter or sign-aware aggregate them deliberately rather than summing quantity blindly. customer_id is null for about 29.8 percent of rows, so any customer-level aggregate must either exclude those rows explicitly or report them as an unattributed bucket. description can be null on a small fraction of lines and still carries source whitespace, so match on stockcode rather than on description text.
limitations: Exact duplicate rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.011188, roughly 506 of 45228 rows) are collapsed, but near-duplicates that differ in any business field are kept and are not detectable from this profile. The declared grain is a hypothesis from distinct counts (invoice 2330, stockcode 3141, invoice_date 2004) and has not been measured against the warehouse; repeated stockcodes on one invoice would break it. customer_id nulls (13468 rows) are retained and never imputed, price includes 0.0 rows that may be giveaways or adjustments, and description whitespace and casing are not normalised.
